notes:
- Digitizing Lab shares the editor’s light and dark colors and has its own GitHub download and update channel.
- Use Design → Digitizing Lab for automatic artwork conversion. The editor’s older Auto Digitize dialog has been removed.
- Color controls open without a hex field. The main editor and Lab share the compact hue and shade picker.
- Removed unused preview and menu code. Showing and hiding objects now reuses the existing preview buffer.
